# Scrap Multitool

A craftable starter tool with cutting, hammering and prying qualities. A small playable Lua example, not a full content pack.

## How to play

Enable in a new world. Your character receives one scrap multitool (check the ground if storage is full). Inspect its tool qualities or activate it. Craft another from two scrap pieces with a rock.

Item ID: `ccb_scrap_multitool`; MOD ID: `scrap_multitool`.
Baseline: `0.Ag-Candidate-2026-09-05-0219`, Lua API 1.

An original CCB-maintained teaching MOD, not a third-party community submission.
Compatible with the other examples in this repository. In-game text displays English and Chinese together; it does not assume an external MOD translation loader.
Use a new test world; do not remove item-adding MODs from important saves.
